_metadata.description: Port-compliance auditor: verify each exposed scenario declares a fixed UI port in service.json matching the manifest, and report violations.

requirements.title: Detect a manifest port that does not match the scenario's service.json
requirements.description: For each manifested route the auditor reads the scenario's service.json fixed UI port and reports a violation when it differs from the route's local_port.

requirements.title: Report a scenario that declares no fixed UI port
requirements.description: An exposed scenario whose service.json declares no UI port produces a missing-port finding rather than being silently passed.

requirements.title: Flag a ranged (non-fixed) UI port as non-compliant
requirements.description: A scenario whose service.json declares a port range instead of a single fixed UI port is flagged as non-compliant, since ranged ports break stable ingress.

requirements.title: Return a clean report when all exposed ports comply
requirements.description: When every manifested route's local_port matches a fixed UI port in the scenario's service.json the audit reports zero violations.
